business_summary: Daily greens and nutrient powder subscription service targeting health-conscious, habit-tracking individuals who buy supplements or work out regularly.
stated_claims: Target is health-conscious people who track habits and already buy supplements or work out regularly

relevant_tags.why: The product is a daily nutrient powder supplement.
Nutrient powders are highly adjacent to and often categorized with vitamins.
The brand is a direct-to-consumer wellness product.
The business model is explicitly subscription-based.
Daily greens powders are heavily marketed for and associated with gut health.
Powdered greens mixed with water function as a daily wellness beverage.

persona_conflicts.conflict: disinterested_in: luxury-only messaging / high price sensitivity
persona_conflicts.evidence: $79 a month is a premium price point for a supplement

note_signals.why: Fitness-engaged shoppers with strong crossover in wellness perfectly match the target audience who work out regularly.
Users actively spending on self-care and fitness align with the target demographic.
Values-driven organic grocery shoppers are highly receptive to clean-ingredient wellness products.
Direct competitor selling vitamins and supplements on a subscription model.
Strong overlap with wellness and premium grocery fits the health-conscious target profile.

gate_reason: The product, price point, subscription model, and target audience are clearly defined, allowing for immediate planning.
missing_info: Specific key ingredients or certifications (e.g., organic, non-GMO, vegan)
Whether a one-time purchase or trial option is available
clarifying_questions: Are your daily greens organic, non-GMO, or vegan?
Do you offer a trial size or one-time purchase option, or is it strictly subscription?
What are the primary health benefits (e.g., energy, digestion) you want to highlight in the creatives?
